description: Wren's cathedral (1675–1710): the lead dome on its colonnaded drum with the stone lantern, gilded ball and cross; the two Baroque west towers with open colonnaded stages and gilt pineapples; the two-storey west portico and pediment; the transepts' semicircular porches; Portland stone and grey lead.
